description: Customer order (sales order) of the ERP, Level 4 above the MOM boundary; bound by the demo plant's ERP source erp-customer-orders. Its status speaks the B2MML RequestState vocabulary (core 5.0.0). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/customer-order.md, description.

refStatus.reason: The reference is kept as a value: ISA-95 has no link from a Level-4 customer order (owner 25.09.: only ISA-95 edges).

properties.name: quantity
properties.description: Ordered piece count of the order line (menge). Together with unit_price the source for total_amount — the real ERP does not keep an order total: order value = quantity × unit_price (derived by the it-evaluator).

properties.name: unit_price
properties.description: Unit price of the order line (stueckpreis). Together with quantity the source for total_amount (= quantity × unit_price).

properties.name: total_amount
properties.description: Order value. Delivered directly where available; otherwise derived by the it-evaluator as quantity × unit_price (the real ERP has no total column). Driver of the €-impact prioritization (expected_impact).

properties.name: due_date
properties.description: Customer delivery commitment (the promised date the sales order is due).

properties.name: status
properties.description: Sales-order status in the B2MML RequestState vocabulary (MESA B2MML, the XML implementation of IEC 62264: B2MML-Common.xsd RequestState1Type); a source maps its own values with valueMap. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/customer-order.md, attributes › status › description.

properties.name: customer_due_date
properties.description: Customer delivery date of the order (moved here from ProductionOrder in core 3.0.0).

properties.name: article_ref
properties.description: The article the order line is for (FK to Article.article_no).

refStatus.reason: Kept as a value: the customer order is an extension above the MOM boundary, ISA-95 has no edge from it (owner 25.09.: only ISA-95 edges).

properties.name: article_name
properties.description: Name of the ordered article as the ERP prints it on the order.

properties.name: production_order_ref
properties.description: The production order that makes this order line (FK to ProductionOrder.production_order_no).

refStatus.reason: Kept as a value: the customer order is an extension above the MOM boundary, ISA-95 has no edge from it to the OperationsRequest it triggers.

properties.name: parent_order_ref
properties.description: The customer order this one was split from (split order, suffix -S1); empty on an unsplit order.

refStatus.reason: Kept as a value: a split of a Level-4 sales order, no ISA-95 object.

properties.name: status_source
properties.description: The ERP's own sales status word, unmapped (status carries it in the B2MML RequestState vocabulary). Values measured over 26 304 orders 19.11.2026.

properties.name: status_code
properties.description: The ERP's numeric order status code as delivered (order_status). Values measured over 26 304 orders 19.11.2026.

properties.name: confirmed
properties.description: The order is confirmed to the customer (order confirmation sent).

properties.name: confirmed_delivery_date
properties.description: Delivery date confirmed to the customer in the order confirmation.

properties.name: actual_delivery_date
properties.description: Date the order was actually delivered; empty while not delivered.

properties.name: created_at
properties.description: When the order was created in the ERP.

properties.name: updated_at
properties.description: When the ERP last changed the order.

properties.name: closed_at
properties.description: When the ERP closed the order; empty while open.

constraints.name: order_overdue
constraints.description: Open customer order past its due date (delivery delay against the customer commitment).
constraints.retiredReason: RETIRED. The guard is structurally unsatisfiable: `when: status eq 'offen'` keys on a value this attribute CANNOT carry. Measured 2026-07-12 against the FULL population of the reference simulator — all 47.513 customer orders, paginated (the endpoint caps a page at 500; a page is not a population). The measurement and the full reasoning: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/customer-order-retirement.md.

constraints.name: customer_order_overdue
constraints.description: An open customer order (B2MML RequestState before an end state, not Forecast) is past its due date: the delivery commitment is missed. Follows retired:order_overdue@2026-07-12. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/customer-order.md, constraints › customer_order_overdue.

isa95.note: Level-4 sales order (B2MML/ERP, above the MOM boundary; no momDomain, audit L5). Triggers a Level-3 OperationsRequest (ProductionOrder) — status speaks its B2MML RequestState vocabulary. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/customer-order.md, isa95 › note.
isa95.mappingNote: Level 4 sales order. ISA-95 stops at the MOM boundary; B2MML 0701 has no SalesOrder object.
